Interest Groups

Explore Communities that Speak to You

Music & Memories

Share the soundtracks that shaped your journey. This community is for swapping playlists, discussing past concerts, and revisiting the music that continues to resonate today.

Travel & Trails

Connect with others to exchange practical travel hacks and weekend getaway ideas. Plan group trips or discover scenic walking trails based on shared recommendations.

Cinema & Stories

Join discussions on movies, series, and documentaries. Share honest reviews and talk about the cinematic moments that mirror real-life experiences.

Books & Beyond

A dedicated space for readers to share current favorites. Swap book recommendations and engage in conversations about stories that offer fresh perspectives.

Fitness & Movement

Focus on longevity and physical well-being. Share sustainable workout routines, yoga tips, and encouragement for maintaining an active lifestyle.

Food Explorers

A group for those who appreciate authentic culinary experiences. Share personal recipes, recommend local restaurants, and join community-led food trails.

Women’s Wellness

A supportive community where women come together to nurture mind, body, and soul where we embrace the journey of healthy aging, mindful living, and holistic wellness.

Where Experiences Take Centre Stage

Words to inspire

Read our insightful blog articles

10 Signs of Midlife Crisis and How to Navigate Them
What actually happens in midlife is simpler and harder to talk about. Certain patterns begin to repeat across people who otherwise have little in common. Their work no longer absorbs them the way it once did. Decisions feel heavier. Time is assessed differently. Relationships start carrying questions they did not earlier. None of this is dramatic enough to justify alarm, yet persistent enough to demand attention.
Hobbies
What Does Midlife Crisis in Women Look Like?
For women navigating both professional and personal lives, it often manifests as burnout or the realisation that success did not automatically translate into fulfilment. Across different life paths, the common thread remains the same: a desire for alignment between who one is and how one is living.
Hobbies
Inside Aprisio’s Journey Through 2025
2025 marked Aprisio’s first year of building a midlife community rooted in presence, curiosity, and connection. This reflection traces how shared experiences, slow living, and meaningful conversations helped redefine what midlife can look and feel like—one cup of chai at a time.
Hobbies
Midlife Identity: A Gentle Unpacking of Who You’ve Become
Midlife identity shifts aren’t dramatic crises—they’re quiet recalibrations. This blog explores why questions of self emerge in your 30s and 40s, how roles lose meaning, and how curiosity can replace confusion as you begin authoring a more authentic life.
